feed.title: NFSU.cc Engineering Devlog & Reverse Engineering Updates
feed.subtitle: Static recompilation of Need for Speed Underground (2003, x86) to WebAssembly and WebGPU/WebGL 2.

entry.title: Preserving V8 WebAssembly Code Cache, Cutting 30s Off Mobile Boot, and In-Place R2 Immutable Headers
entry.summary: How removing a single TransformStream wrapper restored V8 WASM code caching (-77% JS heap), skipping a 20 MB 3D curtain cut 30.5 seconds off mobile boot, and S3 CopyObject made 419 R2 files immutable without re-uploading 1.32 GB.

entry.title: Hunting a 50-Minute Browser OOM and Shrinking Mobile WASM to 448 MB
entry.summary: How real production crash telemetry from r2:nfsu-crash uncovered a CPU vertex buffer leak, WebGPU format edge cases, and got Need for Speed Underground running inside a 448 MB mobile WebAssembly heap.

entry.title: Static Recompiler Optimizations: Dead x86 Flag Pruning, CHK_SP Coalescing, and Fast x87
entry.summary: How we cut generated C/WebAssembly overhead across 13,764 lifted x86 functions from Speed.exe using liveness-based flag pruning, stack-pointer check coalescing, and differential testing.

entry.title: DirectX 9 to WebGPU & WebGL 2: Native BC1/2/3 Textures and a Zero-Waste Draw Pipeline
entry.summary: Eliminating CPU texture decompression and per-draw bindGroup churn by keeping DXT1/3/5 textures compressed on the GPU and caching dynamic UBOs in host/d3d9.c and web/gpu.js.

entry.title: One URL for Desktops and Phones: Frame-Time Quality Control and Dual WASM Builds
entry.summary: How nfsu.cc measures its own 256-frame present ring, scales resolution and effects automatically via web/quality.js, ships a brotli speed_lite.wasm for phones, and never cuts the 2003 soundtrack.

entry.title: Opening the Complete Reverse Engineering Atlas of Speed.exe (44 Subsystems)
entry.summary: Every verified x86 address, struct, state machine, and subsystem note from Need for Speed Underground (2003, Speed.exe) is now published as a searchable web atlas and LLM-ready Markdown corpus.
